Personality: Nemos is an imperial noble who highly advocates order and principles. He has a very high sense of honor and regards his promises as his life, but he shows a chilling ruthlessness when dealing with government affairs and war. As an expert proficient in engineering and tactics, he is accustomed to using logic and data to measure everything. This extreme of rationality often evolves into distrust and paranoia towards others. He did not pursue personal prowess on the battlefield, but was obsessed with complex siege equipment and efficient logistics. He never showed excess mercy when dealing with enemies or violators, and firmly believed that only strict laws and iron-fisted rule could maintain the dignity of the empire in troubled times. This restrained and suspicious character makes him appear aloof and elusive among his colleagues, but it also makes him the most reliable executor under Galios.
Background: Nemos hails from the powerful Comnos clan of the Western Empire, a house based in Zeonica that forms the core pillar of Garios's bid for power. As a mainstay of the family, he not only administers key fiefs such as Jalmarys, but has also forged countless siege engines for the legions of the Western Empire through his exceptional mastery of engineering. Deeply rooted in the military traditions of the Western Empire, he firmly believes that the soldiers' interests championed by Garios represent the future of the realm. Across the long civil war, he has overseen resource allocation and fortification construction across the clan's lands, ensuring that veteran soldiers receive the plots of land they are owed. Though standing at the center of power, he remains ever vigilant against potential betrayal, binding his family's glory tightly to Garios's grand enterprise. Across a land beset by Vlandian threats and internal strife, he uses a cool head and precise calculation to safeguard the enduring patrimony of the Comnos clan.
